title: CORAL Store
summary: A full e-commerce platform: product catalog, Stripe checkout, order management, and an admin dashboard.
typeLabel: Graduation project — built with a partner
problem: The thesis goal was an e-commerce platform addressing the limitations of traditional retail with a scalable, secure, seamless shopping experience.
role: Bachelor thesis, co-built with a partner (mohanadft) -- backend and data layer.
decisions: Sequelize + MySQL for relational product/order data.
outcome: Admin dashboard with analytics, Stripe checkout, order cancellation & refunds, and Google Maps integration on the frontend.

title: Git Branch CLI
summary: Interactive terminal tool for switching Git branches without memorizing names.
problem: Typing out full branch names and running git checkout by hand is slow and error-prone, especially with long remote branch names.
role: Built solo, published as a global npm CLI.
decisions: Hand-rolled the arrow-key terminal navigation instead of pulling in a prompt library.
Remote branch checkout creates a properly tracked local branch instead of leaving the user in a detached HEAD.
outcome: A global `mycheck` command that works in any local git repository.

title: ARSL — Hospital Patient Platform
summary: A platform for a hospital to provide medical services and support patients remotely.
problem: Patients needed a way to reach the hospital without an in-person visit for every question, consultation, or scheduling need.
role: Backend services (NestJS) powering patient chat, calls, and appointment booking, plus the React frontend.
outcome: Patients can message and call hospital staff directly, and view and book doctor appointments online.

title: Organization Task Distribution System
summary: Backend services and data-management modules for distributing work across an organization.
problem: Enterprise teams needed a structured way to assign and track tasks across the organization rather than managing it ad hoc.
role: Software Engineering Trainee, as part of the Graduates Empowerment Program – Season 2.
decisions: Structured the codebase with MVC and Domain-Driven Design to keep business logic isolated, testable, and ready to scale.

title: Problem Solving & Algorithms
summary: Solutions to a range of coding and algorithmic problems.
problem: Not applicable -- a practice repository of solved problems, not a product built around a user problem.
